name: Bloodmage: Adrenaline carries a -25% duration modifier for root, snare and bleed (#1785)
contract: Adrenaline 300986: "Reduces the duration of bleed, root, and movement slowing effects against you by $s1%." All three effects are aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD with amount -25 and TargetA 1 (the Bloodmage itself), carrying MiscValue 7, 11 and 15 = MECHANIC_ROOT, MECHANIC_SNARE and MECHANIC_BLEED (SharedDefines.h:1409/1413/1417) - exactly root, movement slowing and bleed. The reduction is applied by Unit::ModSpellDuration (Unit.cpp:12134-12161), which picks the strongest negative modifier per mechanic and AddPct's it onto the duration. HARNESS LIMIT: that reduction can only be observed on a debuff an enemy really casts on the Bloodmage. Fixture creatures spawn REACT_PASSIVE and never attack, two fixture players are not mutually attackable, and the set_aura fixture goes through Unit::AddAura, which never calls ModSpellDuration (its only callers are Spell.cpp:3224 and SpellEffects.cpp:4105, both on the real cast path). This scenario therefore asserts what the harness can observe - that all three aura 232 effects exist and each carries -25 - and the duration reduction itself needs a Ghost e2e test in which a hostile NPC lands a root, a pure snare (not one that also carries MECHANIC_DISORIENTED, which Unit.cpp:12147 skips) and a bleed on the Bloodmage and compares each aura's duration against a control character without 300986.
